high_level_description: This image depicts a modern living room with a contemporary design aesthetic. The room features a combination of light gray sofas with wooden frames, arranged around a central coffee table made of the same wood material. The coffee table is adorned with a decorative arrangement of white flowers in a vase and some small decorative items. The floor is covered by a large area rug with a geometric pattern in shades of blue, gray, and white, which adds a pop of color to the otherwise neutral palette of the room.
